what_i_found: Vector Shift combines phase matching with surface-relative racing across open roads, the inside and outside of orbital tubes, and jump gaps. A phase change can turn the same line into a speed lane or a safe route through an energy gate, so steering, colour choice and boost timing become one decision. Its 24 courses gradually combine these choices into a continuous racing rhythm.
